exposure: maternal fertility status (in vitro fertilization, subfertile, fertile)
outcome: placental complications (placenta abruptio, placenta previa, vasa previa)
cohort: The study population included 10,352 women with twin pregnancies (6090 fertile, 724 subfertile, and 3538 in vitro fertilization) whose twin live births occurred in Massachusetts between 2004 and 2010.
finding: Risks of all maternal and most infant adverse outcomes were increased for subfertile and in vitro fertilization twins, with highest risks for uterine bleeding and placental complications for both groups, and neonatal and infant death notably higher in the subfertile group.
followup_time: Up to 1 year (for infant death), and up to 28 days (for neonatal death)
